# Command cheat sheet {#sec-cheatsheet}

## Setup (every new terminal)

```bash
conda activate rnaseq-tools            # the book's tools
source ~/omics-walkthru-practice/env.sh   # $WALK, $DATA, $REF, $SALMON_INDEX, $HISAT2_INDEX, $GTF
```

## Clusters (SLURM)

```bash
ssh <user>@<cluster address>
srun -n 1 -c 4 --mem=8g -t 2:00:00 --pty bash           # interactive job (add -p <partition> if needed)
sbatch script.sh                                          # submit
squeue -u $USER                                           # my jobs
sacct -j JOBID --format=JobID,JobName,State,Elapsed,MaxRSS
scancel JOBID
module avail <tool>; module load <tool>/<version>; module list
```

## Files and text

```bash
pwd; ls -lh; cd dir; mkdir -p dir; cp a b; mv a b; du -sh dir
less -S file          # page, no wrap (q quits, / searches)
head -n 20 file; tail -n 20 file; wc -l file
cut -f1,3 file; sort -k2,2n file; uniq -c; grep -w word file
awk '$5 > 100' file; column -t file
cat -A file           # show tabs (^I) and line ends ($, ^M$)
md5sum file; md5sum -c checksums.md5
```

## Compressed files

```bash
zcat f.gz | head; zless f.gz; zgrep pattern f.gz
gzip f; gunzip f.gz; gzip -c f > f.gz; gzip -t f.gz
```

## FASTQ / FASTA

```bash
echo $(( $(zcat R1.fastq.gz | wc -l) / 4 ))        # reads
zcat R1.fastq.gz | awk 'NR%4==2' | head             # sequences only
seqkit stats *.fastq.gz
samtools faidx genome.fa; samtools faidx genome.fa chr1:1000-2000
grep -c ">" transcripts.fa
```

## GTF / BED

```bash
grep -v "^#" x.gtf | cut -f3 | sort | uniq -c       # feature types
awk '$3=="gene"' x.gtf | grep -w 'gene_name "GAPDH"'
sort -k1,1 -k2,2n x.bed > x.sorted.bed
bedtools intersect -a a.bed -b b.bed -u
bedtools getfasta -fi genome.fa -bed x.bed -s
cut -f1,2 genome.fa.fai > genome.chrom.sizes
```

## BAM

```bash
samtools view -H x.bam                 # header
samtools view x.bam | head             # alignments
samtools view x.bam chr7:5500000-5600000   # region (needs .bai)
samtools view -c -F 260 x.bam          # primary mapped reads
samtools flagstat x.bam; samtools idxstats x.bam
samtools flags 163                     # decode a FLAG
samtools sort -o y.bam x.bam; samtools index y.bam
samtools merge out.bam a.bam b.bam
```

## bigWig

```bash
bigWigInfo x.bw
bigWigToBedGraph x.bw stdout -chrom=chr7 -start=5527000 -end=5531000
bamCoverage -b x.bam -o x.bw --normalizeUsing CPM --binSize 10
```

## bagPipes

```bash
sbatch RNApipe.sh                                    # run
./unlock.sh rna                                      # after a killed run
grep -A 15 "Error in rule" RNApipeCore-*.out         # what failed
snakemake -s workflows/RNApipeCore.snakefile --configfile config/RNAconfig.yaml -n   # dry run (in env/)
```

## R

```r
txi <- readRDS("output/quant/<runName>_tximport.rds")
dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = coldata, design = ~ condition)
dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds); res <- DESeq2::results(dds)
```
